title: In silico evolutionary origin, structural properties, molecular docking, following expression analysis of the nitrate transporters in maize to explore their roles in abiotic stress tolerance.
authors: Mia, Md Sohel; Li, Rui; Yang, Tao; Li, Fang; Mi, Jianbo; Xia, Chao; Rahman, M Atikur; Hasan, Md Mahmudul
journal: Physiology and molecular biology of plants : an international journal of functional plant biology
one_liner_zh: 该文对玉米硝酸盐转运蛋白进行系统发育、结构预测和分子对接分析，并验证其表达，虽涉及蛋白-小分子对接和转运蛋白，但非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合体系，且方法以常规生物信息学为主，与课题核心关联较弱。
abstract: Nitrogen (N), which serves as the structural building block of protein, is essential for long-distance transfer from source to sink in plants for proper growth and development. Long-distance N transport occurs through either diffusion-based passive transport or active transport mediated by transporter proteins. In maize, N transporters have a significant impact on long-distance N transport and total N accumulation in seeds. To investigate the critical roles of these transporters in nutrient balance, total N accumulation, and tolerance to abiotic stresses, a series of bioinformatics analyses, following qRT-PCR, and experimental subcellular localization were conducted. Following phylogenetic analysis, maize nitrate transporters (ZmNRTs) shared three different clades (NRT1/PTR, NRT2, and NRT3). Significant differences in molecular weight, as well as multiple beta-strands, multiple alpha helices, and transmembrane helices, were observed in ZmNRTs. The majority of the transporters are found to be localized in the plasma membrane. The transporters showed the highest homolog pairs (63) with S. italica, revealing their similar functional properties. Gene ontology analysis reveals that ZmNRTs play significant role in biological processes, cellular components, and molecular functions. During molecular docking analysis, the lowest binding affinity (DeltaG: - 3.7 kcal/mol) in ZmNRT1c4D-Nit might reveal their binding integrity. During protein-protein interaction, significant interaction of 75 transporters among 83 might be due to their cumulative/interactive roles in the same signaling pathways. Significant upregulation of ZmNRT1.1C, ZmNRT1.6A, and ZmNRT1.6B, in node and tassel tissues during qRT-PCR and RNA-Seq experiments might guide their great impact on N transport in vegetative and reproductive tissues. In the same experiments, significant upregulation of ZmNRT1.3 and ZmNRT1c4C under heat stress in root tissue might guide their great role in heat stress tolerance in maize. Altered expression of ZmNRT1.1C and ZmNRT1.1E under salinity stress, and ZmNRT1.3 under drought stress, might guide their great role in the respective stress conditions. Co-expression of transcription factors, LOC778437 with ZmNRT2.4B and ZmNRT2.4C genes might reveal their regulatory effect in high-affinity NO(3) (-) transport and accumulation in maize. Bioinformatics-based prediction following GFP-tagged expression of ZmNRT1.6B protein in plasma membrane might reveal its great role in cellular NO(3) (-) transport through the cellular membrane. These bioinformatics-based structural analyzes, following wet lab-based validation of maize NRTs, might guide the maize biologists in developing NRT-based genetic circuits to improve the N uptake, transport, mobilization, and accumulation in maize following programming-based genetic circuit-enabled synthetic biology approaches. SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: The online version contains supplementary material available at 10.1007/s12298-025-01669-0.
abstract_zh: 氮（N）作为蛋白质的结构构建模块，对于植物体内从源到库的长距离转运以保障正常生长发育至关重要。长距离氮转运通过基于扩散的被动运输或由转运蛋白介导的主动运输实现。在玉米中，氮转运蛋白对长距离氮转运及种子中总氮积累具有显著影响。为探究这些转运蛋白在养分平衡、总氮积累及非生物胁迫耐受性中的关键作用，进行了一系列生物信息学分析、qRT-PCR及实验性亚细胞定位。经系统发育分析，玉米硝酸盐转运蛋白（ZmNRTs）分为三个不同分支（NRT1/PTR、NRT2和NRT3）。ZmNRTs在分子量以及多个β-折叠、多个α-螺旋和跨膜螺旋方面存在显著差异。大多数转运蛋白定位于质膜。这些转运蛋白与粟（S. italica）具有最高的同源对数量（63），揭示其相似的功能特性。基因本体论分析表明，ZmNRTs在生物过程、细胞组分和分子功能中发挥重要作用。在分子对接分析中，ZmNRT1c4D-N的最低结合亲和力（DeltaG: -3.7 kcal/mol）可能揭示其结合完整性。在蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用中，83个转运蛋白中75个的显著相互作用可能归因于它们在相同信号通路中的累积/交互作用。在qRT-PCR和RNA-Seq实验中，ZmNRT1.1C、ZmNRT1.6A和ZmNRT1.6B在节和雄穗组织中的显著上调可能表明其对营养和生殖组织中氮转运的重要影响。在同一实验中，热胁迫下根组织中ZmNRT1.3和ZmNRT1c4C的显著上调可能表明其在玉米热胁迫耐受性中的重要作用。盐胁迫下ZmNRT1.1C和ZmNRT1.1E以及干旱胁迫下ZmNRT1.3的表达改变可能表明其在相应胁迫条件下的重要作用。转录因子LOC778437与ZmNRT2.4B和ZmNRT2.4C基因的共表达可能揭示其对玉米高亲和力NO(3)(-)转运和积累的调控效应。基于生物信息学的预测及ZmNRT1.6B蛋白在质膜中的GFP标记表达可能揭示其在细胞通过细胞膜进行NO(3)(-)转运中的重要作用。这些基于生物信息学的结构分析，结合湿实验室验证的玉米NRTs，可能指导玉米生物学家开发基于NRT的遗传回路，通过基于编程的遗传回路使能的合成生物学方法，改善玉米中氮的吸收、转运、动员和积累。补充信息：在线版本包含补充材料，可访问10.1007/s12298-025-01669-0获取。
